strategy: BTCUSDT common non-ATR strategy stability audit
selection_rule: Within each family, select on train and validation only: maximize the weaker return, then combined return, then lower drawdown. Confirmation is not used for selection.

base: positive net return in each disjoint split
at least six completed trades in confirmation
maximum drawdown no worse than -25% in every split
at least 55% positive calendar months in confirmation
stress: repeat all three splits at 10 bps fee plus 5 bps slippage per fill
remain positive in each split with no drawdown worse than -25%

decision.reason: No candidate survived the predefined multi-split, drawdown, trade-count, monthly-consistency, and cost-stress gates.
